items.question: Which goddess form appears first in the sequence of Kālikā manifestations?
premises: She is described black and red-hued.
items.inference: The verse identifies Kālikā as the first named form in an ordered list of goddess manifestations.
uncertainties: The exact form following tataḥ is not supplied in this verse.
